body:
Found by the first cold start on a repo that is not hkb on 2026-08-27 (a private, org-owned monorepo with live CI).

A bare `hkb init` on a Claude-only repo created six profiles and **16** `kb:*` labels:

    wrote .kanban/board.json (board "default", profiles claude, claude-track, claude-p, claude-action, copilot-cli, codex)
    created labels: ... kb:agent:claude, kb:agent:claude-track, kb:agent:claude-p, kb:agent:claude-action, kb:agent:copilot-cli, kb:agent:codex

**Cause.** `init()` seeds `cfg` from `DEFAULT_BOARD` (`src/board.js:87`), whose `profiles` is the whole of `DEFAULT_PROFILES` (`src/board.js:19` — six keys), then only fills in profiles that are *missing* (`src/init.js:337-343`). So `--profiles claude` adds nothing and removes nothing: the flag can only widen, never narrow. The help text `init [--profiles claude]` implies otherwise.

**Consequence for an adopter.** Five unusable `kb:agent:*` labels on their repo, and `hkb doctor` warns forever about things they will never use:

    ! copilot         not on PATH
    ! codex           not on PATH
    ! copilot harness missing .github/agents/kanban-worker.agent.md, ...
    ! codex harness   missing .codex/hooks.json, ...

A permanently non-green doctor teaches people to ignore doctor.

**Fix.** On a *fresh* board (no existing `.kanban/board.json`), seed `cfg.profiles` from the resolved profile list rather than from all of `DEFAULT_PROFILES`. `loadBoard` already implements exactly this — "keep only what the user declared, each merged over the default of the same name" (`src/board.js:184-186`) — so init should match its sibling. Re-running init on an existing board must stay additive: never delete a profile the operator added by hand.

**Verify.** `hkb init` on a fresh repo yields `claude` only and 11 labels; `--profiles claude,codex` yields two and 12; a second `init` over an existing board leaves hand-added profiles untouched. Unit-test beside the existing `resolveProfiles` cases in `test/harness.test.js`.
title: init --profiles cannot narrow the board: every adopter gets all six profiles
